roles.description: Your playable map needs readable pixel-art ground tiles, buildable cells, paths, water, soil, rock, and clear placement, selection, and demolition states.
roles.label: Settlement terrain and build grid

roles.description: Your survivors need distinct, readable pixel-art bodies with movement and task feedback for hauling, farming, cooking, crafting, medicine, mining, forestry, eating, sleeping, injury, and illness.
roles.label: Colonists and work animations

roles.description: Your settlement needs coherent pixel-art structures and workstations for shelter, storage, cooking, medicine, crafting, farming, and related construction and demolition states.
roles.label: Buildings and production stations

roles.description: Your simulated goods need recognizable pixel-art visuals for raw materials, food, medicine, tools, crafted items, hauled objects, and stocked or spoiled states.
roles.label: Resources, tools, and stockpiles

roles.description: Your farming, forestry, and mining loops need clear pixel-art crops across growth stages, harvestable trees, stone, ore, and depleted states.
roles.label: Crops, trees, and mineable nature

roles.description: Your world simulation needs readable pixel-art wildlife and hostile or hazardous entities with movement, attack, injury, defeat, and other gameplay-relevant states where applicable.
roles.label: Wild animals and threats

roles.description: Your simulation needs visible pixel-art feedback for rain or snow, temperature and seasonal change, day and night, fire and smoke, crop stress, and food spoilage.
roles.label: Weather, fire, seasons, and world effects

roles.description: Your desktop-browser game needs a readable English interface for resources, building, work priorities, colonist inspection, needs, mood, relationships, alerts, event logs, save and load, pause, speed, start, and pause menus.
roles.label: Colony management interface
